title: Graph Explorer
intro: A graph is a set of vertices connected by edges. Choose a traversal algorithm and follow, step by step, how it explores the graph from a starting vertex.

bfs.name: Breadth-First Search
bfs.summary: Explores the graph in layers: first the vertices one edge away from the start, then those two edges away, and so on. It uses a queue.

dfs.name: Depth-First Search
dfs.summary: Follows a path as deep as possible, then backtracks to the most recent vertex that still has unexamined neighbors. It uses a stack.
